description: nhflow_2d_sediment_feed without suspended load, non-equilibrium bed load S 33 1 with Ls = S 40 = 2 m and no bed load supply at the inflow (S 129 1, S 130 0): the supply is the upwind value of the non-equilibrium solve (the inflow ghost cells of qbn, sediment_exner::qb_inflow), the transport grows from zero and the erosion is spread over Ls behind the inflow. Before, the solve started from qb = qbe at the inflow and the deficit stayed in the first cells.
